mapper.select:
select id, jibie_bianhao as jibieBianhao, jibie_mingcheng as jibieMingcheng, yue_feiyong as yueFeiyong, zhuangtai, miaoshu from huli_jibie
zhuangtai != '已删除'
and jibie_mingcheng like concat('%', #{jibieMingcheng}, '%')
and zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}
order by id desc
select id, jibie_bianhao as jibieBianhao, jibie_mingcheng as jibieMingcheng, yue_feiyong as yueFeiyong, zhuangtai, miaoshu from huli_jibie where id = #{id} and zhuangtai != '已删除'
mapper.update: update huli_jibie set jibie_bianhao = #{jibieBianhao}, jibie_mingcheng = #{jibieMingcheng}, yue_feiyong = #{yueFeiyong}, zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}, miaoshu = #{miaoshu} where id = #{id}
update huli_jibie set zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai} where id = #{id}
update huli_jibie set zhuangtai = '已删除' where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into jibie_xiangmu (jibie_id, xiangmu_id) values (#{jibieId}, #{xiangmuId})
